remarks: East Norwalk beach area apartment recently updated w/plenty of natural light. This apt is located above UC Bagels on 2nd fl. - Entrance in rear. Open floor plan. Kitchen w/ granite counters & stainless appliances. Recessed lighting and beautiful hardwood flooring. Private deck & 3 season porch off of Kitchen. Stackable washer & dryer in apt. Central Air & efficient gas heat pump. Located in a walk to everywhere 06855 neighborhood. Commuter's delight - minutes to S. Nwlk & E Nwlk train stations and only 55 mi north of NYC. Minutes to water and beaches, restaurants, SoNo. Please submit Application, Credit & background in 1 PDF. Must have excellent credit & references. 2 mos Security plus 1st month's rent due at lease signing. $100,000 liability policy must be carried by Tenant t/o term of the lease. Apt will be cleaned & painted prior to move-in.
